The carapace is barely higher than the short legs and hugs the ground, with the same low shell height, the same width and the same body volume in every view: the front view, the side view and the rear view all show this one flat shield at one shared scale. A broad scalloped apron of plates spreads outward from the centre and sits close to the ground, its rim nearly touching the surface, and the short legs are mostly hidden beneath the plated edge. Bright sulphur-yellow mineral crust builds up in the plate seams and rings and coats the snout plate and the mouth. The head is carried low and nose-down against the ground, with small eyes, and ends in a broad, flat rasping snout plate whose mouth is rimmed in yellow mineral. The overall form is a flat, wide stone disc pressed to the ground with a broad scraper snout. Even soft lighting, the creature centred and filling the frame by its width, nothing else in the image.
